**Job Description

**Are you driven by designing robust software architecture and solving complex system-level challenges in high-performance, real-time environments? Do you want to build systems that turn raw sensor data into precise and real-time metrics that golfers and broadcasters rely on?

At Trackman, we combine radar technology, computer vision, and data intelligence to redefine how golf is played, practiced and experienced. From local golf clubs to live TV broadcasts, our products set the global standard for accuracy, performance, and innovation.

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to play a central role in architecting and evolving the software systems behind Trackman Range and Golf Broadcast.

In this role, you will design and own key parts of our real-time data processing platform, ensuring it is scalable, maintainable, and performant under demanding conditions. You will work at the intersection of software engineering and applied algorithms, translating mathematical models and signal-processing concepts into robust, production-grade systems.

You will be responsible for system-level design decisions, improving software architecture, and driving engineering quality across the codebase. This includes diagnosing complex system behavior, addressing performance regressions, and ensuring high standards of reliability, testability, and maintainability.

**Job Requirements

****The Ideal Candidate Has

**

• A master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field

• Strong expertise in C++ and Python, with a track record of building high-performance, production-grade systems

• Experience designing and owning scalable software architectures and real-time data processing pipelines

• Strong understanding of performance engineering, multi-threading, and system-level debugging (e.g., concurrency issues, performance regressions)

• Experience driving code quality, testing, CI/CD, and managing technical debt in production systems

• Experience with Linux-based systems for development, deployment, and debugging of distributed applications

• Experience with Docker for containerization and orchestration of those applications

• 5+ years of relevant experience with ownership of critical systems or components

**Other Valued Experience

**

• Radar technology, signal processing, numerical algorithms and sensor fusion

• Computer vision, tracking, and camera calibration

• Deep learning model implementation and optimization

• Real-time camera and video systems, including stream handling, data capture and encoding/decoding

• GPU acceleration and performance profiling

**The Office

**We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

**Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

**Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

**Where innovation happens

**At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

**Share our Passion!

We are looking for a Frontend Engineer to build the customer-facing applications that allow our customers monitor the health of over one million connected devices and configure them on their own. Whether you have a couple of years of experience or a few more, we would like to see your application.

Make an impact at device scale. You will work on our device health and device configuration applications: helping customers avoid non-reporting units and the downtime that comes with them, and putting device configuration in their own hands, so the right data reaches our platform. You will work with one of the most advanced IoT frameworks out there, side by side with product managers and product designers, and with AI as part of how our team builds.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Own your part. You drive your work from idea to production, make decisions yourself and push changes, supported by sparring partners.

• Work with AI every day. Our team has a shared AI development workflow, and AI is a daily part of how we build.

• Work closely with Product and Design. Your day-to-day partners are a product manager and a product designer, so your ideas turn into shipped features together.

• Learn and share. A frontend community, training, conferences and agentic development workflows, with learning at the centre.

• Grow over time. Through impact conversations, the community and your colleagues, with you as the main driver, in an international tech company that uses continuous integration and deployment.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a frontend engineer who ships, and is just as comfortable asking questions as making decisions.

• Hands-on experience with React (our main framework), Node.js and TypeScript, ideally on complex product environments. An IoT background is a plus, but we value navigating a complex domain more than any specific industry.

• You are results-driven: you ship features fast, dare to try, and are not afraid of asking questions, failing, or reaching out to people online or face to face.

• You work independently and take ownership: you show initiative, make decisions and follow your work through to production.

• You are a mix of technical expert and good communicator, able to explain your choices to product managers, designers and senior colleagues.

• Nice to have: GraphQL, REST APIs and MCP servers, backend exposure (Java, Spring Boot, Databricks, Postgres, AWS).

AI is part of how our team builds software, including a shared AI development workflow. Hands-on experience is a plus, but curiosity and a genuine interest in working with it matter more.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**

• Improve our device health tools so customers avoid non-reporting units and the downtime that follows.

• Build self-service device configuration for customers, such as profiles that make sure the right data reaches our platform.

• Ship features fast, in close collaboration with product managers and product designers, and keep quality high with tests and code reviews.

• Look beyond the existing tools: avoid dead ends in device health and help create a more seamless experience across our device landscape.

• Share what you learn with our engineering community and talk about what the future brings in frontend.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Initial conversation with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other.

• Meet the hiring manager to talk through your experience and what drives you, in person where possible.

• Practical case that you prepare in advance and discuss with colleagues you will work closely with. The conversation matters more than the deliverable.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're excited to welcome you to Trackunit!

Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport is part of the Nordic Supply Chain team and responsible for strategic sourcing and category management at Group level within transportation, third-party logistics (3PL), warehouse equipment, packaging materials and load carriers, and, where relevant, selected third-party manufacturing. • Fluency in English and proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language, both written and spoken.

We are looking for a proactive, accountable, analytical, and solution-oriented professional who enjoys working in an international environment. You have excellent communication and organizational skills and thrive when collaborating across functions, countries, and cultures.

A service-minded, flexible approach combined with a continuous improvement mindset will be essential for success in this role.

Application

We welcome your application for the position of Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. About the Job

We are looking for a Senior Security Architect to shape and strengthen security across Stibo DX products, platforms, and cloud services. You will join a small, senior architecture team at the center of Stibo DX's transformation from self-hosted and hybrid deployments to a standardized, cloud-native SaaS platform.

This is a hands-on, embedded role. You will work with engineering, product, platform, operations, customer-facing teams, and legal to ensure security is built into our solutions by design, not added afterwards. You will turn security strategy and risk into practical architecture, reusable patterns, and controls that teams can implement.

Your goal is to establish a consistent security architecture across Stibo DX and give teams clear standards, patterns, and guardrails to make secure architecture decisions. Early priorities will include establishing a security architecture baseline, identifying key security gaps across our SaaS platform, strengthening security architecture reviews and threat modelling, and defining reusable security patterns for engineering teams.

The role is primarily focused on security architecture, product and platform security, and secure engineering practices. You will also drive the technical aspects of security governance and support compliance activities when needed, including security certifications, customer security requirements, regulatory obligations, risk assessments, policies, and audit preparation.

You will work alongside peer architects covering Software, Platform/Infrastructure, and Data/Integration, reporting to the Director of Solution Architecture. Our governance model is based on minimum necessary control: decisions close to teams, with oversight proportional to risk and impact.

Security remains a shared responsibility. The Senior Security Architect owns the security architecture direction, standards, patterns, and cross-cutting guidance, while Software, Platform/Infrastructure, and Data/Integration architects continue to consider and address security within their respective domains. Engineering teams remain responsible for implementing and operating the required controls.

What You'll Do

• Define security architecture strategy across Stibo DX products, platforms, and cloud services, including principles, standards, target architectures, guardrails, and roadmaps.

• Embed secure-by-design practices into product discovery, solution design, delivery, and operation, working with teams early rather than reviewing security only at the end.

• Lead security architecture reviews and threat modelling for product, platform, customer, and technology initiatives; identify risks and align on practical mitigation with accountable teams.

• Shape identity and access management covering authentication, authorization, federation, privileged access, service identities, secrets, and Zero Trust principles.

• Strengthen cloud and platform security for AWS, Kubernetes, networks, workloads, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, data, and shared SaaS platform capabilities.

• Define reusable security patterns and controls for APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, encryption, key management, logging, monitoring, vulnerability management, and secure configuration.

• Embed security in the software development lifecycle by defining practices and guardrails and helping teams integrate security into engineering practices, automation, architecture decision records, and delivery pipelines.

• Lead security governance and compliance work when needed including security policies, control design, risk assessments, evidence coordination, audit preparation, and remediation planning.

• Translate external requirements into technical action including customer security expectations, contractual commitments, privacy requirements, and relevant frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, and CRA.

• Raise security maturity across Stibo DX through coaching, practical guidance, cross-team collaboration, and clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What we're looking for

Experience

• 10+ years of experience across software engineering, cloud/platform engineering, or cybersecurity, with 4+ years in a senior security architecture or technical security leadership role.

• Proven experience designing and securing cloud-native, distributed, and microservices-based systems in production.

• Practical experience with SaaS and multi-tenant architectures, including tenant isolation, identity, data protection, and shared platform controls.

• Experience leading threat modelling, security architecture reviews, risk assessments, and remediation planning across multiple teams or product areas.

• Experience defining security standards, patterns, reference architectures, and governance that teams can apply in practice.

• Experience working with security and compliance frameworks and translating them into proportionate technical and organizational controls.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to influence engineers, architects, product leaders, operations, customers, legal, and senior stakeholders.

Technical expertise

• Cloud security, preferably AWS, and Kubernetes/container security.

• Identity and Access Management, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, federation, privileged access, and service identities.

• Application, API, integration, and event-driven security.

• Network security, workload protection, secrets management, encryption, certificates, and key management.

• Secure software development lifecycle, DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD security, and software supply-chain security.

• Security logging, monitoring, detection capabilities, vulnerability management, and incident preparedness.

• Threat modelling, security risk analysis, Zero Trust, and defense-in-depth principles.

Nice to have

• Experience leading or materially supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR security controls, CRA, or similar initiatives.

• Experience with enterprise customer security assessments, contractual security requirements, and audit evidence coordination.

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience helping an organization establish or mature a security architecture and governance capability.

Personal qualities

• Hands-on and credible with engineers, while able to communicate security clearly with product, customers, legal, and leadership.

• Pragmatic and risk-based: able to balance security, usability, operational complexity, cost, and delivery speed without compromising critical controls.

• Collaborative and influential, using expertise, evidence, and trust rather than creating unnecessary gates.

• Structured and decisive, able to make risks, responsibilities, and architectural decisions explicit.

• Curious, adaptable, and motivated by building long-term security maturity while helping teams deliver now.

We are looking for a full stack engineer who is at home on both sides. On Android you will work on the apps that run on our terminals, including the app that lets a POS drive the terminal and the app that takes the payment itself. On the backend you will work on the Terminal API, the service that connects terminals, POS systems and the Flatpay platform.

You will take real ownership, with freedom to drive technical decisions and a direct impact on how payments are made at a company that has gone from startup to unicorn at record speed.

jobs.occupation: MCO is searching for a Project and Community Manager
jobs.description:
Help us shape the future of media and technology.

The media industry is changing faster than ever. AI, new technologies and changing audience habits are transforming how we create, distribute and consume content.

At Media City Odense (MCO), we’re bringing together the people and organisations who want to shape what comes next.

Now we’re looking for an ambitious, creative and hands-on Project & Community Manager to join our team in Odense and help take MCO to the next level.

A small team. Big ambitions.

Media City Odense is a growing innovation hub and community connecting some of Denmark’s leading media companies, technology businesses, startups, researchers and educational institutions.

Founded by TV 2 Denmark, JFM, TV 2 Fyn and the University of Southern Denmark, we’ve built a strong foundation for collaboration, innovation and knowledge sharing. And we’re just getting started.

Our ambition is to become Denmark’s leading national hub for media technology and innovation. A place where new ideas turn into real projects, where talent meets opportunity, and where the industry comes together to develop the solutions of tomorrow.

From our annual MediaTech Festival to industry events, innovation projects and new partnerships, we’re building a community that creates value all year round.

And that’s where you come in.

As our new Project & Community Manager, you’ll play a central role in turning ideas and ambitions into activities, experiences and tangible results.

You’ll work closely with our CEO, Event Manager and the wider MCO community, taking ownership of projects while helping develop and strengthen our organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Project management: Plan, coordinate and execute projects and initiatives, from the first idea to the final delivery.

• Events & experiences: Help develop and deliver workshops, networking events, industry sessions and our annual MediaTech Festival.

• Community & relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with our members, partners and stakeholders, ensuring they experience real value from being part of MCO.

• Marketing & communications: Create engaging content for our website, newsletters, social media and other communication channels, including basic visual and graphic content.

• Business development: Contribute ideas, identify opportunities and help develop new initiatives that support MCO’s growth and ambitions.

• Making things happen: Keep projects, partners and priorities moving forward, including the practical details that make the difference.

You’ll have plenty of opportunities to put your own ideas into action, take responsibility and make a visible impact on the organisation.

Who are you?

We’re looking for someone who combines structure with creativity, initiative with execution, and professionalism with a healthy dose of curiosity.

You enjoy working with people, you’re comfortable taking ownership, and you don’t need a detailed instruction manual to get started.

Ideally, you:

• Have experience with project management, events, communications, community building or a related field.

• Are highly organised, proactive and comfortable managing several projects at once.

• Have strong communication skills and can create engaging written and visual content.

• Have a good eye for design and are comfortable using digital tools to produce presentations, social media graphics and marketing materials.

• Enjoy building relationships and working with people across different organisations and industries.

• Are curious about technology, AI, innovation and the future of media.

• Communicate confidently in both Danish and English.

• Thrive in a small team where responsibilities are broad, decisions are made quickly and everyone contributes.

Experience from the media or tech industry is an advantage, but not a requirement. We’re just as interested in your mindset, initiative and ability to deliver as we are in your CV.

What do we offer?

At MCO, you’ll join a small, dedicated team with ambitious plans and the freedom to help shape how we achieve them. You’ll get:

• Real influence: An opportunity to shape projects, activities and the future development of MCO.

• An exciting network: Direct access to leading media companies, technology innovators, entrepreneurs and decision-makers.

• Variety and responsibility: A broad role where no two weeks look quite the same.

• Room to grow: Opportunities to develop professionally, take ownership and explore new ideas.

• A collaborative culture: An informal working environment built on trust, initiative, curiosity and a shared ambition to make a difference.

We’re based in central Odense, working at the intersection of media, technology and innovation, with a growing network across Denmark and beyond.

Ready to join us?

We’d love to hear from you.

Send your CV and a short application telling us who you are, what motivates you and why you’d be a great fit for Media City Odense.

Apply by email: thhah@mediacityodense.dk

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, and expect to complete the recruitment process during November 2026.

The position is full-time, based in Odense, with a start date to be agreed upon.

Come help us build what’s next.

We are an experience innovation and digital transformation consultancy. We are responsible for the end-to-end product development for some of the biggest brands in the world. We build innovative AI-driven digital experiences used by millions of customers across retail, e-commerce, finance, automotive and other sectors. Operating across five continents with over 6,000 innovators in twenty-two countries, we help organizations reimagine the way they connect with their customers and transform their business operations.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

• The work we do and innovation we drive

• Our Values of share, care and dare

• A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy

• Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The Role:

Valtech Denmark is looking for new enterprise clients. You will be the person that will help win them.

As our Executive Business Developer, you will showcase to Danish enterprise leaders Valtech’s Intelligent Enterprise proposition which connects AI, data, technology, customer experience and operating models to deliver tangible business outcomes.

This is not a conventional sales role. You hunt like a seller, think like a management consultant, use AI and data in your own work and bring the right colleagues in early. You are relentless about results, and you never make the sale about yourself.

You report to the Managing Director, Valtech Nordics, and work day to day with colleagues in strategy, data and AI, experience design, technology and delivery, and with Valtech’s international network of expertise.

Role Responsibilities:

• Own new logo acquisition: identify, engage and win new enterprise clients across Denmark, running every stage from target selection and first contact to pitch, negotiation and close

• Build and execute a GTM plan focused on high-value target accounts and priority industries

• Build relationships with CEOs, COOs, CIOs, CMOs, CDOs and other senior decision-makers

• Open every conversation with a hypothesis about the client’s business, not our service catalogue, and link AI opportunities to the data, processes, technology and organizational capabilities needed to realize value

• Pull strategy, data and AI, design, technology and delivery colleagues in early, and lead pursuits and RFP responses through influence rather than ownership of every idea

• Co-sell with strategic partners (Adobe, Salesforce, Sitecore, Optimizely, Contentful, hyperscalers, etc.), including joint AI-led propositions

• Use AI and data across prospecting, meeting preparation, proposals and forecasting, and keep Salesforce disciplined so the pipeline and forecast can be trusted

• Deliver against your agreed new-business target and represent Valtech at industry events and partner activations

What we expect of you:

• Hunter: You open doors instead of waiting for leads, and can say exactly what you personally contributed to each win.

• Orchestrator: You compete on outcomes, not ego, and share credit with the specialists you involve.

• Consultant mindset: You ask sharp questions, challenge assumptions and frame problems that matter to the business.

• AI and data native: You use AI in your own work, know where it fails and tie it to real business problems, as a commercially credible bridge rather than a technical specialist.

• Energy builder: You bring pace, optimism and a bias for action, backed by a plan and real client conversations, not slogans.

Must have Qualifications:

• Proven track record winning net-new enterprise logos in a digital agency or consulting environment, with a clear view of your personal contribution

• Experience selling complex, multi-million euro engagements across digital experience, data, technology and AI-enabled solutions

• A strong network in Denmark, ideally including senior decision-makers and C-suite relationships

• Exceptional consultative sales skills, with the ability to translate business challenges into impactful digital and AI-enabled strategies

• Practical understanding of how AI and data apply in commercial and customer experience contexts, including where they fall short

• Deep understanding of one or more key industries (e.g., Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences)

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex client organizations and mobilize internal specialists

• Strong communication and storytelling skills, with fluency in Danish and English

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a permanent position based in Denmark.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

• Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs

• Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen, Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.
